result.summary: Found 2 issues: a major layout issue with truncated content and a minor text truncation problem.

issues.description: The restaurant card at the bottom of the 'Popular right now' section is cut off, showing only the pizza image and discount label without the restaurant name, delivery info, or rating
issues.suggestion: Ensure all restaurant cards have sufficient space within the viewport or implement proper scrolling/pagination to display complete card information

issues.description: Restaurant name 'Trattoria Piccol' in the 'Fastest near you' section appears truncated, likely should be 'Trattoria Piccolo' or another complete name
issues.suggestion: Display the full restaurant name or use text overflow ellipsis (...) as a fallback for long names
